headword: {病魔|びょうま}と{闘|たたか}う
gloss: to battle illness; to fight a disease

definitions.gloss: to battle illness; to fight a disease; to struggle with a long illness
definitions.explanation: A set expression describing someone enduring a serious or prolonged illness. {病魔|びょうま} personifies disease as a demon, so the phrase carries a sense of dignified struggle, especially in news reports and obituaries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧{病魔|びょうま}と{闘|たたか}った。
examples.english: He battled illness for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{病魔|びょうま}と{闘|たたか}い⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: My grandfather kept fighting his illness until the very end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって{病魔|びょうま}と{闘|たたか}い⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: She continued her writing while battling illness for many years.

notes:
A formal set expression. {病魔|びょうま} literally means "disease demon," personifying serious illness as an adversary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧{病魔|びょうま}と{闘|たたか}う: to battle illness for a long time
- {病魔|びょうま}と{闘|たたか}い⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to keep fighting one's illness
- {病魔|びょうま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to fall to illness (the related contrast; lost the fight)

REGISTER:
Used in formal writing, news, and obituaries. In casual speech, people simply say ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧ or ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}そう→治す：19371_naosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The ⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧ kanji (heavier than ⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧) emphasizes a hard, sustained struggle.
